title: NFZillionaire
tagline: NFTs for real estate owners and for creating DeFi zillionaire clubs.
description: This project is about turning real estate properties into NFTs and for grouping these real estate NFT holders into investment clubs or what I call NFZillionaire clubs. These NFZillionaire clubs could then invest in other DeFi or crypto assets or projects broadening the amount of capital entering these markets.
how_its_made: This is a react app modeled on the Fleek's crypto museum. It uses Fleek's IPFS and Filecoin storage methodology. At the moment there are some issues I have to work out and time is running out. Additionally, Truffle was used as well as Ganache for testing. I wanted to add in the LivePeer example but ran out of time.
